title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Dust hangs in the air, lit by a single flickering lamp. Rows of old books line the walls — you are locked inside a library. The only exit is a heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad.
room_description: A small, dim library. You can see a desk, a tall bookshelf, an oil painting, a grandfather clock, a dusty rug and a heavy oak door with a keypad.

desk.name: desk
desk.description: An old oak desk covered in scratches. A torn note lies on top. The desk has one built-in drawer with a small combination lock.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: A tall shelf of dusty books. Three of them stand out: each spine is marked with a single hand-painted digit. From left to right: a green book marked 2, a red book marked 5 and a blue book marked 8.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: An oil painting of three scholars reading. From left to right they hold a red book, a blue book and a green book. Nothing is hidden behind the frame.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.description_locked: The desk drawer is locked with a three-digit combination lock.
drawer.on_unlock: The lock clicks and the drawer slides open. Inside lies a small UV flashlight.

clock.name: grandfather clock
clock.description: A grandfather clock that stopped long ago. Its hands point to 9:15. A brass plate beneath the face reads: 'When light fails, time holds the end.'

rug.name: rug
rug.description: A dusty Persian rug. You lift a corner — there is nothing underneath but floorboards.

door.name: door
door.description_locked: A heavy oak door. A four-digit keypad glows faintly beside the handle. It is firmly locked.
door.description_open: The door stands open. Fresh air flows in.
door.on_unlock: The keypad turns green. With a heavy clunk the bolts slide back and the oak door swings open. You step out of the library — you are free!

torn_note.name: torn note
torn_note.description: A torn piece of paper. In faded ink: 'Order matters. Ask the painting.'

uv_flashlight.name: UV flashlight
uv_flashlight.description: A small ultraviolet flashlight. It casts a faint purple glow.

interactions.text: Under the purple light, glowing letters appear on the desk surface: 'The door begins with 47.'
interactions.repeat_text: The glowing letters are still there: 'The door begins with 47.'

interactions.text: You sweep the purple light over the painting. Nothing glows.
The book spines show nothing new under the UV light.
You hold the note up to the painting. The colours of the scholars' books seem to matter.

hints.text: Some of the books on the shelf look different from the rest.
The torn note says to ask the painting. What are the scholars holding?
Read the book digits in the order of the colours in the painting.
Something useful is inside the open drawer.
Ultraviolet light reveals invisible ink. Try it on the furniture.
The clock has stopped. What time does it show?
You now know how the door code begins and how it ends.
